channel.title: MeetChrisC
channel.description: Notes from the second half — retirement, letting go, and starting over in Austin.

item.title: 11 P.M. at Crunch Southpark Meadows
item.description: I work out at 11 p.m. seven nights a week. Moving to Austin, every house got measured against one question: how far is the nearest gym that's open at midnight?

item.title: Say Nothing, and Mean It
item.description: You read the long angry message at 11:52 at night, wrote three replies in your head, and sent none of them. On silence, and when it's a fence, not a fist.

item.title: The Quiet Kind of Strong
item.description: The strongest people I know show up, hold it together in public, then sit in the truck for twenty minutes before going inside. On grief, healing, and peace.

item.title: Why I gave up all my furniture — and why I'll never go back
item.description: The movers wanted $14,000–$20,000 to move my furniture from LA to Austin. I gave away 95% of it. What I kept, what I miss, and why the house feels perfect.

item.title: Why I started this site
item.description: I retired in January and started learning to build on the web with AI. This site is where I practice.
